dict.string: Jarvis listens for “Hey Jarvis”. The wake word and your words are recognised on this Mac; only the request you make after the wake word is sent on to Jarvis.
Jarvis uses Apple’s on-device speech recognition to hear its wake word and your requests. Audio is not sent to Apple.

Jarvis uses the camera only when you ask it to look at something. One picture is taken (or a few seconds for “watch”), sent to Claude for that request, and never saved. The camera turns off straight away.
Jarvis controls an app only when you ask it to — for example running a command you asked for in Terminal, closing Finder windows, or closing its own interface tab in your browser.
